specials.note: measured from Logan Wolf's three Cavernam visits (capture 20261031_170158, 2026-10-31 21:15:20-21:23:30, 21:30:04-21:41:40, 21:43:01-21:47:04; docs/NOTES.md "Cavernam: three visits by hand, dead on level 3"): per creature, the numbers on our side after its cue with the victims' and the spared ones' distances. Every number was taken under Logan's Song of Discordance (17.7 % to 21:27:30, 18.0 % 21:30:22 to his death, 17.2 % from 21:43:52) and is divided here by (1 - that share), docs/SIM.md's rule (the World cuts it again). Not modelled (seen; too few, no harm or no mechanic): the frozen dead's '*raises frozen remains*' (4: two frozen remains beside it 0.02-0.25 s later, 0.6-1.4 s after it went to war; harmless, 1 number of 5 on a pet) and '*absorbs essence*' (2: one of its remains dies at that instant); the lemura's '*warded*' (10, 4.9-9.9 s apart: the pets' damage reflected, 8 numbers in our hue 89 on them: 15-28 six times, 282 and 60 together on AlaFlambe 21:44:39.6; no reflect kind); the stalagfright's '*jettisons*' (1: pets 12-13 at +0.78 and +1.35 s, Logan 7, at 3-4 tiles); the icy lurker's '*vomits*' (1: Logan 16, 17, 18 at 10-12 tiles 1.42-1.95 s after, the pets at 10 spared); the hoarfrost's '*groans*' (2: once 77/85 on the pets on one tile beside it 0.75 s after, Logan at 4 spared; the type's only numbers); the cave gorger's '*gorges*' (1: 39-95 on both pets 0.27 s before it, an icy dracolisk beside them); the rhinocerus beetle's '*charges*' (1, from 13-16 tiles, no hit); the rime elemental's '*shield bashed*' (over it, the player xander xavier beside it [INFERENCE: his bash]); the ursal forager's '*applies poison to weapon*' (2, no poison on us after) and '*applies herbal poultice*' (3, its own heal); the frigid archfiend's '*enraged*' (3, no number after); the frost daemon's, rime spirit's and icy dracolisk's chill on single hits (frost daemon spell 101-117 on AlaFlambe with Bussin on the same tile spared, 3; no debuff rider on a ranged or melee hit); the colossal frost scorpion's Deadly poison on Logan (1, 21:36:57.1, '*wracked with extreme pain*', cured 1.1 s later). 'You are no longer hindered.' (7) is Logan's own traversal: each 1.07-1.14 s after 'Where do you wish to traverse to?' Chill on its victims (the wyrmling's and archfiend's area hits, the frost daemon's, rime spirit's and dracolisk's single hits: '*chilled*' / 'You feel chilled!'): not modelled, its size never measured (no slow on Logan's steps). Bursts' `action`: the cast animation World sends at the cue (the silicite's action 12 sent 50 times over 1.5 s, the charoite's 11, the wyrmling's and archfiend's 5, the throatsinger's 27).
